title: A clear post-forum follow-up timeline will convert investor interest into qualified deal engagement through **4** managed steps

phases.title: Immediate lead capture keeps forum momentum intact and turns raw interest into actionable investor records
phases.body: Consolidate all investor conversations, tag them by sector and interest theme, and assign next actions before attention shifts away from Angola after the forum.

phases.title: Targeted materials sustain interest by giving each investor a sharper Angola case and relevant opportunity set
phases.body: Send tailored follow-up packs that match each investor's sector focus, preferred entry model, and discussion points so early interest becomes more specific.

phases.title: Qualification calls separate curiosity from intent by testing mandate, timing, and fit with Angola opportunities
phases.body: Use structured outreach to confirm which investors have active appetite, credible sector alignment, and a realistic path to deeper engagement with IFC Angola.

phases.title: Structured dialogue advances qualified leads into active deal pursuit with named owners and clear next steps
phases.body: Move the strongest prospects into a managed pipeline with bilateral meetings, deeper diligence materials, and agreed follow-up steps tied to specific opportunities.
